facts.fact: Le Soleil says the New Deal technologique, the Senegalese digital transformation strategy, was 'lancé il y a un an' (launched a year ago, i.e. 2025); it names no adopting act or body.

Citing a ministry document, the article lists first achievements one year on (e-Senegal single window, universal connectivity, national interoperability platform, Sengec, Startup Act labelling, e-Consulat) without measuring them against stated targets.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication, Telecommunications and Digital Affairs
Ministry of Communication, Telecommunications and Digital Affairs

note: The document presents the strategy as a lever for transforming the state with a startup component, and does not say it covers the economy and the state, so class is left empty. It mentions a public-projects monitoring-and-evaluation platform without tying it to targets.
